scope: Read-only diagnosis of app-hosted Release XCTest startup; no build, launch, retry, settings changes or device-session changes performed by this diagnostic task.

failure.message: The test runner exited with code 74 before establishing connection.

timeline.event: Mac connected to testmanagerd; test-runner session transport acquired; listening for test-bundle proxy connection.
Session initiation returned without an error.
The development-signed host app launched with PID 5964.
Host framework reported Exiting due to IDE disconnection.
Launch session expired; XCTest coordinator reported runner exit 74 before connection.

ruledOutWithinEvidenceScope: Compilation or test assertion failure as the reported failure stage.
Missing development debugger permission on the currently inspected Release host.
An obviously incorrect BUNDLE_LOADER executable or missing embedded test bundle in the observed Release link/install path.
notEstablished: The underlying cause of the test-bundle-to-IDE connection loss.
A dyld or missing-symbol failure; no such explicit diagnostic appears in the collected logs.
A concurrency conflict with another IDE session; this remains unproven.
A causal relationship between PointerUI XPC warnings and runner termination.
A confirmed Xcode27.2/iOS27.2 regression or Release-only configuration defect.
decision: Stop runner retries. Parent task is validating the real optimized Release app with a DEVICE_QA-gated on-device probe, without XCTest injection or persistent IDE control. This receipt does not claim that probe has passed.
